title: In the Service of Online Order: Tackling Cyber-Bullying with Machine Learning and Affect Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a classifier to detect cyber-bullying on Japanese BBS sites using Support Vector Machines and affect analysis. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith systems, or specific frameworks of moral or ethical reasoning; rather, it treats cyber-bullying as a category of harmful social behavior for detection via text classification.
